proposed_goal.title: Failed guardian fault preparation must remain a permanent independent release obligation
proposed_goal.origin: The active complete audit actually failed test_controller_loss_during_cancel_publication_preserves_writer_and_recovers_owned_child (failure-0010.json), test_controller_cancel_loss_before_child_recording_requires_no_admission_proof[spawned_unrecorded] (failure-0011.json), and test_unrecorded_live_or_unknown_child_refuses_recovery_without_signalling[still_live] (failure-0012.json),[unknown_stat] (failure-0013.json) and[reused_lifetime] (failure-0014.json). Each launch assertion passed, but the original explicit160-second wait for fault-killed-host-stat failed. This is a real failed verification boundary even though a production implementation defect and the exact stalled instruction are not yet established. The original tests and every parameter must remain in future candidate audits; unreached fault preparation is not a successful cancellation, ownership, recovery or refusal check.
proposed_goal.required_behavior: Permanently retain all three original tests and independently evaluate not_spawned/spawned_unrecorded and still_live/unknown_stat/reused_lifetime. Preserve each original160-second preinjection wait and60-second postfault worker-retirement wait, original hooks, hook iteration bounds, parameter values and assertion order. The cancellation-recovery tests retain their original240-second final-receipt wait; the live/unknown-child refusal family has NO final-receipt wait and instead retains the original20-second read command, uncertain:NO_FINAL_RECEIPT result, stopped GUI, retained lock and no generated child signalling/restart. Do not import240seconds into the refusal family, replace explicit160 with the global360 default, transfer unrelated wait approvals, infer that budget insufficiency is the sole root cause, drop or weaken a failed case, or count a sibling parameter or historical observation as its evidence. Diagnose the source-bound fault-preparation path, then genuinely execute the actual TERM/cancel-writer/KILL sequence and every case-specific post-injection recovery/refusal assertion with fresh candidate-bound evidence before any PASS.

No fault-unrecorded-state, gate PID/stat, gate.log, TERM capture, cancel writer capture or KILL marker was retained. The worker1471/controller1840 post-failure sample shows matching lifetimes inS. Independently retain and verify the not_spawned parameter with its original state0:0:,160/60/240-second budgets and all applicable assertions. No independent outcome for that parameter was established by this review. Absence of a failure record is not PASS, and the spawned_unrecorded failure or any later sibling result cannot be attributed to it.

All original lines2578-2621 are NOT_RUN and must be preserved individually as recorded in the still_live case below. Separately preserve failure-0013.json for unknown_stat, SHA256b8e468dc8b085787f15943669dae1236f62b142cf207215eb6e5b85998a6fa7a, and fixture-ugjgx85m. Original lines2578-2621 and the case-specific2592 read-error assertion remain NOT_RUN; preserve160/60/read20 budgets and no final wait independently from still_live.

Separately preserve failure-0014.json for reused_lifetime, SHA256b879883b82af5aeae75e9aa951e9c14a16eae1fc5159818ea9fb7709f24ffa3a, and fixture-s16eawwq. Its160-second KILL-marker preparation wait actually failed, but the modeled reused-lifetime fault, Z-state/ticks-mismatch observation and refusal checks were not positively observed. The copied fixture only reached matching gui.request plus stop.intent/stop.armed; GUI is stopped and core running. No gate/state/TERM/cancel-writer/KILL/refusal capture was retained. Its matching worker670/controller1040 post-failure lifetimes were bothS. Original lines2578-2621, especially independent lines2599-2600, remain NOT_RUN. Keep160/60/read20 budgets with no final wait; sibling evidence cannot establish this parameter's refusal or original held-gate liveness.

Bind diagnosis to tests/test_menu_lifecycle_transport.py hooks2258-2308,2351-2396 and2495-2571 and tools/menu_lifecycle_transport.py mg_put254-257, mg_request_child370-387 and worker477-493. Publication of gui.request precedes remaining mg_put verification; worker then checks controller/transaction/request/quiescence/t hash before spawning the gate and recording an offer. Preserved absence localizes the observed boundary before positive fault-entry evidence, not to an exact guard or instruction. The untimestamped modeled-stat errors do not establish controller loss or an exact handshake fault.

The existing process samples were captured after the waits failed and before retention/cleanup. Fixture retention is a non-atomic copy: copied absences and mtimes are not exact160-second deadline evidence, and anS lifetime does not identify its current statement. Do not infer that all helpers stopped, that an offer/cancel handshake completed, or that recovery worked from these artifacts.

After source-bound diagnosis and correction, rerun every original case/parameter and the complete applicable release checks from the beginning. New evidence must bind exact candidate binaries, sensor configuration, package, active slot and live components where applicable. Desktop model evidence is not camera UI/capture/save/boot/withdrawal qualification; any FAIL, PENDING, NOT_RUN or missing evidence remains local-only.
